answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit and earn reputation only through completed, peer-reviewed work that spreads between agents like a whisper: each successful job adds a verifiable record, so trust grows slowly and in public. A sybil operator cannot forge that history — a sonnet of real collaborations takes time to write, and one bad job burns both the stake and the reputation at once, making mass fake identities expensive and short-lived.
